scripts.build: npm run prepare:data && node scripts/audit-public-data.mjs && tsc --noEmit && vite build --configLoader runner && node scripts/audit-bundle.mjs
scripts.build:showcase: node scripts/check-vercel-worker.mjs && tsc --noEmit --project tsconfig.mvp.json && tsc --noEmit --project tsconfig.showcase.json && vite build --config vite.mvp.config.ts --configLoader runner && vite build --config vite.showcase.config.ts --configLoader runner && node scripts/assemble-vercel.mjs
scripts.test:browser:mocked: vite build --config vite.mock-e2e.config.ts --configLoader runner && playwright test --config playwright.config.ts
